master

master — the Multivariate Axonal Simulator for Tractography Evaluation — generates realistic white-matter bundles (fascicles) with microstructural attributes for evaluating diffusion-MRI tractography. It implements the functional-data-analysis generative design of the MASTER model: a reference centerline pathway (a flat central interaction segment with smooth bending arms, assembled by tangent-angle integration and reparametrized by curvilinear arc length) is perturbed by zero-mean functional random fields of axons expressed in a B-spline basis with exponentially autocorrelated Gaussian coefficients.

master builds on the fiber package (S7 streamline / bundle / bundle_set classes) and emits fiber::bundle objects ready for interactive visualization with rtists.

Installation

You can install the development version of master from GitHub:

# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("tractoverse/master")

Or from a local checkout:

pak::pak("local::/path/to/master")

Example

Generate a single smooth centerline, then populate it with a bundle of perturbed axons:

#| label: example
library(master)

# A straight central segment with two smoothly bending arms
cl <- generate_centerline(angle = 0.6, arm_length = 1,
                          interaction_length = 2, n_points = 200)
head(cl)          # N x 3 matrix, columns X, Y, Z

# A bundle of 20 axons coherently perturbed around that centerline
b <- create_axons(cl, n_axons = 20, n_basis = 8, variance = 0.02,
                  autocorrelation = 2, seed = 1)
fiber::is_bundle(b)   # TRUE
b@n_streamlines       # 20

Build a pre-defined interaction configuration as a fiber::bundle_set

#| label: scenario
st <- simulate_scenario("crossing", n_axons = 10, seed = 1)
fiber::is_bundle_set(st)   # TRUE
st@n_bundles               # 2

# Visualize with rtists (if installed)
# rtists::plot3d(st)

# Export to the master CSV layout for downstream tractography tools
generate_csv(st, tempfile(fileext = ".csv"))

The generative model

Each bundle is grown from a reference centerline whose tangent angle ramps smoothly from -angle to +angle with an exactly flat central segment of length interaction_length (see [generate_centerline()]). The centerline is reparametrized by curvilinear arc length, then each axon is drawn as the centerline plus a smooth functional perturbation modelled as a B-spline expansion of exponentially autocorrelated Gaussian coefficients (see [create_axons()]). Pre-assembled configurations — bending, fanning, merging, kissing, crossing — are available through [simulate_scenario()].

References

The MASTER design follows the functional-data generative approach developed for diffusion-MRI tractography evaluation, building on the fiber package and the rtists visualization stack.

You will still need to render README.qmd regularly, to keep README.md up-to-date. devtools::build_readme() is handy for this.
